mapper.select: select mn.* from Gantt_Tasks_Process mn where mn.task_id=#{taskId}
select mn.* from Gantt_Tasks_Process mn left join Gantt_Tasks gt on mn.Task_Id=gt.Task_Id left join Gantt_Plan gp on gt.Plan_Id=gp.Plan_Id where gp.Plan_Id=#{planId} order by mn.Gtp_Date asc

select dep.D_Name as dName, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Id as pId, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, pro.p_Category as pCategory, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, con.Con_Name as conName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, gp.Plan_Name as planName, mn.* from Gantt_Tasks_Process mn left join Gantt_Tasks gt on mn.Task_Id=gt.Task_Id left join Gantt_Plan gp on gt.Plan_Id=gp.Plan_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=gp.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=gp.Con_Id left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_Id=gp.Plan_D_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Gtp_Id where mn.Gtp_Id=#{gtpId}

select gp.Plan_Name as planName, gt.Task_Doc as taskDoc, gt.Task_Text as taskText, gt.Task_Uname as taskUname, gt.Task_State as taskState, gt.Task_Progress as taskProgress, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Each_District as pEachDistrict, proc.C_Name as pConsName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, sd.D_Name as dName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Gantt_Tasks_Process mn left join Gantt_Tasks gt on mn.Task_Id=gt.Task_Id left join Gantt_Plan gp on gt.Plan_Id=gp.Plan_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=gp.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id=pro.P_Construction_Unit left join Sys_Department sd on sd.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Gtp_Id where 1=1
order by gp.P_Id,mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
select count(1) from Gantt_Tasks_Process mn left join Gantt_Tasks gt on mn.Task_Id=gt.Task_Id left join Gantt_Plan gp on gt.Plan_Id=gp.Plan_Id where 1=1

SELECT pp.P_Name, gt.Task_Text, gs.Gs_Section, gt.Task_Type, gt.Task_Start_Date, gt.Task_End_Date, gp.Plan_Start, gp.Plan_End, gto.create_uname, gto.Create_Time FROM Gantt_Tasks_Process gto LEFT JOIN gantt_tasks gt ON gto.Task_ID = gt.Task_Id LEFT JOIN gant_section gs ON gt.gs_id = gs.id LEFT JOIN gantt_plan gp ON gt.Plan_Id = gp.Plan_Id LEFT JOIN pre_project pp ON gp.P_Id = pp.P_ID WHERE gto.Gtp_Id = #{gtpId}
